newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European feeds see nearby tapioca trade - jan 23.
newsitem.headline: European feeds see nearby tapioca trade - jan 23.

text.p: The European meals and feeds market saw some trades in Thai tapioca pellets as resellers sold off their nearby positions, market sources said.
"It was a quiet day overall as many buyers remained sidelined due to the strong dollar. We only saw resellers selling off some afloat Thai tapioca this afternoon," one broker said.
Afloat tapioca traded at 19 marks per 100 kg fob Rotterdam, Feb also traded at 19 marks and March/June at 20 marks. Afloat Citruspulp pellets traded at $109 and $109.5 a tonne cif Ghent.
No trades were reported in other products.--KAREL LUIMES +3120 504 5832
Feb Brazilian soymeal pellets traded at $288 a tonne cif Rotterdam.
Argentine sunmeal pellets changed hands at $149 a tonne cif Rotterdam for afloat, Feb changed hands at $140.50 and April/June at $130 a tonne cif Rotterdam.

Afloat citruspulp pellets traded $1 up from yesterday at $110 a tonne cif Rotterdam and afloat cornglutenfeed pellets traded at $159 a tonne fob for special quality material.--KAREL LUIMES +31 20 504 5832
